title.en: Foundations: what keeps the house standing

intro.zh: 地基埋进土里就再也看不见，却决定上面的一切是站得直还是慢慢开裂。
intro.en: Once buried you never see it again, yet it decides whether everything above stands straight or slowly cracks.

sources.title: AEDO — Building Foundation Types in the Philippines
AEDO — Rebar Inspection Before Concrete Pouring

text.zh: 选地基形式，最终取决于哪两件事的平衡？
text.en: Every foundation decision is a balance between which two things?

zh: 上部结构传下来的荷载，和接住它的土有多结实
en: The load coming down from the structure, and the strength of the soil receiving it
The colour and orientation of the house

explain.zh: 重楼放在好土上、轻楼放在软土上，需要的地基可能完全不同——所以地基不能照抄别人的，土要实地勘察。
explain.en: A heavy building on strong soil and a light one on weak soil can need completely different foundations — so soil must be investigated, not assumed.

text.zh: 菲律宾低层住宅在良好土层上的标准做法是什么？
text.en: What is the Philippine standard foundation for low-rise houses on competent soil?

zh: 每根柱下一个钢筋混凝土独立基础，再用地梁连起来
en: A reinforced concrete pad under each column, tied together with foundation beams
Lay the blocks straight on the soil

explain.zh: 独立（扩展）基础 + 地梁是菲律宾低层住宅在良好土上的标准；承重空心砖墙下面用条形基础。
explain.en: Isolated/spread footings tied with foundation beams are the PH standard for low-rise houses on competent soil; load-bearing CHB walls sit on strip footings.

text.zh: 把下方的施工回放拨到「基础」，看每根柱子下面的独立基础。
text.en: Move the construction timeline to “Footings” to see the pad under every column.

text.zh: 在 3D 里点一下东南角那块独立基础（方形混凝土垫块）。
text.en: Click the isolated footing pad at the south-east corner.

part.zh: 独立基础：柱子的力通过它摊到更大面积的土上。
part.en: Isolated footing: spreads the column load over a larger area of soil.

text.zh: 浇混凝土前验钢筋：基础底部的混凝土保护层至少多厚？
text.en: Before the pour: how much concrete cover is required under a footing?

explain.zh: NSCP 2015 表 420.6.1.3.1：基础底 75 mm，柱梁 40 mm，室内楼板底 20 mm。钢筋只有浇筑前那一小时能看见。
explain.en: NSCP 2015 Table 420.6.1.3.1: 75 mm under a footing, 40 mm on columns and beams, 20 mm under an indoor slab. The hour before the pour is the only time anyone can see the steel.

intro.zh: 菲律宾在环太平洋地震带上，柱子尺寸和箍筋不是随便定的。
intro.en: The Philippines sits on the Ring of Fire — column sizes and ties are not guesswork.

sources.title: AEDO — Column Size for a 2-Storey House
AEDO — Rebar Inspection Before Concrete Pouring

text.zh: Batangas 在 NSCP 2015 里属于哪个地震区？
text.en: Which NSCP 2015 seismic zone is Batangas in?

explain.zh: NSCP 2015 只有 2 区和 4 区：2 区只有巴拉望（Busuanga 除外）、苏禄、塔威塔威；包括整个吕宋在内的其他地方都是 4 区，Z=0.40。
explain.en: NSCP 2015 has only Zones 2 and 4. Zone 2 is Palawan (except Busuanga), Sulu and Tawi-Tawi; everywhere else — all of Luzon included — is Zone 4, Z = 0.40.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「一层柱」。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Columns”.

text.zh: 点一下东南角那根柱子。
text.en: Click the column at the south-east corner.

part.zh: 钢筋混凝土柱：把楼板和屋顶的重量一路传到基础。
part.en: RC column: carries floors and roof down to the footing.

text.zh: 常听到的 200×200 柱子，按 NSCP 2015 特殊抗弯框架的规定够不够？最短边至少多少？
text.en: Is the popular 200×200 column allowed in an NSCP 2015 special moment frame? What is the minimum shortest side?

explain.zh: NSCP 2015 第 418.7.2.1 条：特殊抗弯框架柱最短边不小于 300 mm。
explain.en: NSCP 2015 Section 418.7.2.1 sets a minimum shortest dimension of 300 mm.

text.zh: 柱和梁的钢筋保护层至少多厚？
text.en: What concrete cover do columns and beams need?

explain.zh: 柱梁 40 mm；另外每个箍筋都要做 135° 弯钩，柱梁端部箍筋要加密。
explain.en: 40 mm for columns and beams; every tie needs 135° hooks, with closer ties near member ends.

intro.zh: 二层楼板是整栋房子的「地板」和「天花」，混凝土要配对。
intro.en: The upper slab is both floor and ceiling — the concrete has to be right.

sources.title: AEDO — Rebar Inspection Before Concrete Pouring

text.zh: 菲律宾住宅工地最常用的结构混凝土 Class A，按体积配比是？
text.en: Class A, the standard structural mix on Philippine house sites, is what ratio by volume?

explain.zh: Class A = 1:2:4；更富的 Class AA 是 1:1.5:3，更贫的 Class C 是 1:3:6。
explain.en: Class A = 1:2:4; richer Class AA is 1:1.5:3, leaner Class C is 1:3:6.

text.zh: 每立方米 Class A 混凝土大约用几包 40 kg 水泥？
text.en: About how many 40 kg bags of cement go into one cubic metre of Class A?

explain.zh: 约 9 包水泥、0.5 m³ 砂、1.0 m³ 碎石出 1 m³ 混凝土。
explain.en: About 9 bags of cement, 0.5 m³ of sand and 1.0 m³ of gravel per m³ of concrete.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「梁板」。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Beams & slabs”.

text.zh: 点一下二层楼板的南边缘。
text.en: Click the south edge of the 2nd-floor slab.

part.zh: 二层钢筋混凝土楼板：由梁和柱托着。
part.en: 2nd-floor RC slab, carried by beams and columns.

text.zh: 室内楼板底部钢筋保护层至少多厚？
text.en: Minimum concrete cover under an indoor slab?

en: 0 mm — touching the form is fine

explain.zh: NSCP 2015 表 420.6.1.3.1：室内楼板底 20 mm。钢筋要用垫块垫起来。
explain.en: NSCP 2015 Table 420.6.1.3.1: 20 mm under an indoor slab — bars sit on spacers.

intro.zh: 菲律宾房子的墙几乎都是空心砖（CHB），加气砖（AAC）越来越多。
intro.en: Philippine walls are mostly concrete hollow blocks; AAC is gaining ground.

text.zh: 把外墙换成「加气砖 AAC」看看效果。
text.en: Switch the walls to AAC block and compare.

text.zh: 一平方米墙要几块 400×200 的空心砖（不算损耗）？
text.en: How many 400×200 CHB per square metre of wall (before waste)?

explain.zh: 理论 12.5 块，加约 5% 损耗按 13 块采购。8.33 块是 600×200 加气砖的数。
explain.en: 12.5 in theory; buy 13 with about 5% waste. 8.33 is the count for a 600×200 AAC face.

text.zh: 空心砖常见的两种厚度是？
text.en: The two common CHB thicknesses are?

explain.zh: 4 寸多用于隔墙，6 寸多用于承重外墙和围墙。
explain.en: 4" for partitions, 6" for load-bearing exterior walls and fences.

text.zh: 只做隔断、不承重的空心砖墙，NSCP 2015 最少要多少钢筋？
text.en: Minimum steel for a non-structural CHB partition under NSCP 2015?

zh: 每 1.2 m 至少一根 12 mm 钢筋（单向），或用灰缝钢筋
en: At least one 12 mm bar every 1.2 m in one direction, or joint reinforcement

explain.zh: 第 709.4.1.3 条。承重或抗震的墙要双向配筋、间距不超过 600 mm、总配筋率不低于 0.2%。
explain.en: Section 709.4.1.3. Load-bearing or seismic walls need steel both ways, ≤600 mm apart, at least 0.2% of the cross-section.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「砌墙」，看门窗洞口是怎么留的。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Walls” to see how openings are left.

intro.zh: 菲律宾每年平均 20 个台风，屋顶被掀是住宅最常见的破坏。
intro.en: About 20 typhoons a year — roof uplift is the most common house failure.

text.zh: 把屋面换成「波纹镀锌铁皮」看看。
text.en: Switch the roof to corrugated GI.

text.zh: 菲律宾住宅在台风中最常见的破坏方式是？
text.en: The most common typhoon failure mode in Philippine houses?

explain.zh: 风在屋顶上方形成负压、下方正压；如果屋架和墙的连接没按上拔力设计，屋顶就会分离。
explain.en: Negative pressure above and positive below lift the roof; if the roof-to-wall connection isn't designed for uplift, it separates.

text.zh: 为什么屋顶往往从一个角先被掀起？
text.en: Why do roofs peel from a corner?

zh: 边角的风吸力常是屋面中部的 2–3 倍
en: Suction at edges and corners is commonly 2–3× the middle

explain.zh: 所以边角区的螺钉要加密——这是最便宜、也最常被省掉的抗台措施。
explain.en: So fasteners must be closer at edges and corners — one of the cheapest and most skipped resilience measures.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「屋顶」。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Roof”.

text.zh: 在台风多发省份，彩钢长瓦厚度的合理下限是？
text.en: Sensible minimum long-span sheet thickness for typhoon-exposed provinces?

explain.zh: 0.4 mm 是常规住宅默认；台风暴露的省份 0.5 mm 更稳妥。NSCP 2015 二类建筑风速图在约 240–320 km/h 之间。
explain.en: 0.4 mm is the residential default; 0.5 mm is the sensible minimum where typhoons hit. The NSCP 2015 Category II map runs about 240–320 kph.

intro.zh: 管线一旦被墙和地砖盖住，改起来最贵。
intro.en: Once pipes are behind walls and tiles, fixing them costs the most.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「砌墙」：水电管线要在墙封起来、地砖铺上之前完成并验收。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Walls”: pipes and conduits must be done and inspected before walls are closed and floors tiled.

text.zh: 卫生器具下面的存水弯，水封深度应在多少范围？
text.en: What water-seal depth should a fixture trap hold?

explain.zh: NPC 第 1005 条：51–102 mm，挡住下水道臭气；还要有通气管（第 1002 条）保护水封不被虹吸抽干。
explain.en: NPC §1005: 51–102 mm blocks sewer gas; a vent (§1002) protects it from siphonage.

text.zh: 化粪池按 NPC 附录 B：液体容量最少多少、第一格至少多长？
text.en: Per NPC Appendix B: minimum liquid capacity and first-compartment length?

zh: 最少 2 m³，第一格至少 1500 mm 长
en: At least 2 m³, first compartment at least 1500 mm long

explain.zh: 第二格至少 1 m³、宽至少 900 mm；每格检修口直径至少 508 mm。
explain.en: Second compartment ≥1 m³ and ≥900 mm wide; a manhole ≥508 mm over each compartment.

text.zh: 家里电表/进户开关的容量，按什么定？
text.en: What decides the size of your electrical service?

zh: 按负荷清单（每个用电器加总、乘需用系数），不是按面积
en: The load schedule (every load totalled, times demand factors) — not floor area

explain.zh: 总连接负荷也是电气许可费的计费依据，负荷表做得马虎会花两次冤枉钱。
explain.en: The same connected load is what your electrical permit fee is assessed on — a sloppy schedule costs twice.

title.zh: 泳池：埋在土里的混凝土结构
title.en: Pools: a concrete structure in the ground

intro.zh: 泳池不是按平米算的院子，它是要对抗土压和地下水的地下结构。
intro.en: A pool isn't priced like a patio — it's a below-grade structure fighting soil and groundwater.

text.zh: 把池面换成「卵石池面」。
text.en: Switch the pool finish to pebble.

text.zh: 泳池放空时为什么可能开裂甚至「浮」起来？
text.en: Why can an emptied pool crack or even lift?

zh: 地下水位浅时，外面的水往上顶，池里没水抵消（静水浮力）
en: With a shallow water table, groundwater pushes up and in with nothing inside to counter it (hydrostatic uplift)

explain.zh: 所以放空泳池要有计划，设计要看土质和地下水位。
explain.en: So draining needs a plan, and the design depends on soil and water table.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「泳池」。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Pool”.

text.zh: 点一下泳池的水面。
text.en: Click the pool water.

part.zh: 下沉式钢筋混凝土池壳 + 防水 + 贴面。

text.zh: 自家后院的私人泳池，需要办什么？
text.en: What does a private single-family backyard pool need?

zh: 作为永久构筑物，仍需普通建筑许可；地方政府可能另加围栏等条件
en: A regular building permit as a permanent structure; the LGU may add enclosure conditions

explain.zh: PD 856 第二十章管的是公共/共用泳池；私人泳池没有专门的全国法规，但仍要建筑许可。
explain.en: PD 856 Chapter XX covers public/shared pools; a private pool has no dedicated national statute but still needs a building permit.

intro.zh: 装修算钱的关键不在单价，在面积。
intro.en: The rate is the easy half — the area is what wrecks budgets.

sources.title: AEDO — Tile & Painting Cost per sqm 2026

text.zh: 把露台和室内地面换成「花岗岩」。
text.en: Switch the terrace and floors to granite.

text.zh: 60×60 cm 的地砖，一平方米要几片？
text.en: How many 60×60 cm tiles per square metre?

explain.zh: 一片 0.36 m²，1 ÷ 0.36 ≈ 2.78。大砖按片看贵，按平米常常更便宜。
explain.en: 0.36 m² each, 1 ÷ 0.36 ≈ 2.78. Large tiles look pricey per piece but are often cheaper per m².

text.zh: 一间 4×5 m 的卧室，地面 20 m²，墙面大约多少？
text.en: A 4 × 5 m bedroom has 20 m² of floor — about how much wall?

explain.zh: 涂料按墙面算，墙面积常是地面的两倍多。
explain.en: Paint is priced on wall area, often more than double the floor.

text.zh: 防水施工里，哪个部位单价最高？
text.en: Which area has the highest waterproofing rate?

zh: 泳池（曲面、台阶、排水口多，施工最慢）
en: Swimming pools (curves, steps, drains — slowest application)

explain.en: 2026 bands: pools ₱730–990/m², flat roofs ₱560–760/m².

text.zh: 把施工回放拨回「砌墙」，对比装修前的毛坯样子。
text.en: Move the timeline back to “Walls” to compare with the bare shell.

title.en: Before buying land: hazards and soil

intro.zh: 很多房子的地基预算翻倍，是因为买地前没查。
intro.en: Many foundation budgets double because nobody checked before buying.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「放线」，看空地和退界带。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Site layout” to see the empty lot and setback strip.

text.zh: 点一下地块北侧（临街）那条前院退界带。
text.en: Click the front-yard setback strip on the north (street) side.

part.zh: 前院退界：这里不能盖房子。

text.zh: 付定金前查一块地的灾害，官方免费工具要多久？
text.en: How long do the free government hazard tools take before you pay a deposit?

zh: 大约 15 分钟，不用注册

explain.zh: 先用 PHIVOLCS 的 HazardHunterPH 定位出多灾种报告，再看 MGB 地质灾害图和当地分区规划。
explain.en: Start with PHIVOLCS HazardHunterPH for a multi-hazard report, then MGB geohazard maps and the local zoning plan.

text.zh: 菲律宾普通建筑场地最常见的土类（NSCP 2015 表 208-2）是？
text.en: Most common soil profile for ordinary Philippine sites (NSCP 2015 Table 208-2)?

explain.zh: SE 软土的地震系数最高；SF（会液化、泥炭、高塑性黏土）必须做专门的场地研究。
explain.en: SE soft soil has the highest coefficients; SF (liquefiable, peat, highly plastic clay) needs a site-specific study.

text.zh: 断层两侧 5 米的禁建带，对哪类土地是法定约束？
text.en: The 5 m no-build buffer either side of a fault is binding law for what?

zh: PD 957 登记的分户/公寓项目；私人单独地块是 PHIVOLCS 建议，除非地方条例写进去
en: Subdivision/condo projects under PD 957; for a private lot it is a PHIVOLCS recommendation unless the LGU ordinance adopts it

explain.zh: HLURB 1992 年 R-515-92 号决议。买地要查当地条例，而不是网上说法。
explain.en: HLURB Board Resolution R-515-92 (1992). Check the local ordinance, not the internet.

intro.zh: 建筑许可是你「按批准图纸」盖房的授权。
intro.en: The building permit authorises you to build — only to the approved plans.

text.zh: R-1 独立住宅按 PD 1096 实施细则表 VIII.2，前院和侧/后院最少退多少？
text.en: Under Table VIII.2 of the PD 1096 IRR, an R-1 detached house needs what front and side/rear yards?

zh: 前院 4.50 m，侧院和后院 2.00 m
en: Front 4.50 m, side and rear 2.00 m

explain.zh: 这是国家建筑法规的最低值；分区条例、分户限制等多层规定同时适用，以最严的为准。
explain.en: That's the Building Code minimum; zoning and subdivision rules apply at the same time, and the strictest wins.

text.zh: 把施工回放拨到「放线」，看示范别墅离北侧地界留了 6 m（大于 4.5 m）。
text.en: Move the timeline to “Site layout”: the sample villa sits 6 m from the north line (more than 4.5 m).

text.zh: 办建筑许可，第一步该做什么？
text.en: What comes first when getting a building permit?

zh: 地方分区办公室确认这块地允许盖你要的东西（通常同时办村级证明）
en: The LGU zoning office confirms your use is allowed on the lot (usually with a barangay clearance)

explain.zh: 用途不允许的话，画整套图纸也没用。
explain.en: No point preparing full plans for a use the lot won't allow.

text.zh: 不办许可就开工，会怎样？
text.en: What happens if you build without a permit?

zh: 建筑费加收 100%（相当于翻倍），还要罚款
en: A 100% surcharge on building fees (effectively double), plus fines

explain.zh: 另外许可证一般自签发起一年内必须开工，否则可能失效。
explain.en: Also, a permit is generally valid for one year to commence work, or it can lapse.

text.zh: 资料齐全的住宅，很多地方政府多久能发许可？
text.en: With complete documents, how long do many LGUs take to release a residential permit?

explain.zh: 拖延几乎都来自资料不全或图纸被退回修改。
explain.en: Delays almost always come from incomplete requirements or plans sent back.
